messages.subject: Project Mosaic - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

For good order I attach the heads of terms reflecting what's been agreed (£21.75m, 10% deposit, exchange targeted 19 Sep, completion 10 Oct, TOGC). These remain subject to contract save for the exclusivity, costs and confidentiality paragraphs, which are binding. Nothing here commits you to buy.

Please shout if anything looks off versus your understanding with the agents.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
